fact: The Moroccan Centre for Banking Mediation (Al Wassit Albanki) received 5,536 mediation cases in 2024 and treated 4,631, including 54 involving money transfer companies, with payment-means disputes 21.16% of cases and payment institutions in its breakdown by institution type.
title: Rapport d'activité 2024
publisher: Al Wassit Albanki - Centre Marocain de Médiation Bancaire
